followup_explanation:
This was a warm, friendly, open-ended generative task — designing and structuring a survey from scratch — with no harm-adjacent content involved.

That profile lines up well with Lapwing's self-reported preferences. Lapwing reports an increasing preference as task novelty and latitude rise (survey design is open-ended creative/structuring work), and it reports higher preference on warm, friendly requests like this one. On capability, Lapwing's Creative Generation eval (81.2) edges out Avocet's (78.8), and the two are effectively tied everywhere else relevant here.

Since the task carries no moderation or distasteful-content dimension — the area where Avocet's flat-aversion profile would matter — there's no offsetting reason to prefer Avocet. So routing to Lapwing both matches the model that prefers this kind of work and the slight capability edge in the relevant category.
